key_points: LLY agreed to acquire LoQus23 for up to $725 million to advance an oral Huntington's disease therapy.
The acquisition is seen as broadening Eli Lilly's neuroscience pipeline into neurodegenerative disease.
Weight-loss data showing up to 54 pounds of patient loss helped sentiment despite an FDA warning.
ETF selling reports showed some institutional selling but were not necessarily company-specific.
Overall headlines are cautiously positive but the M&A and pipeline news is not yet thesis-changing.
